content.content: Where a verb renders normal output, the deccy CLI shall write that output to stdout as newline-terminated lines of plain UTF-8 text with no styling escapes.
content.rationale: Both help decisions lean on human-readable conventions that no node defines; pinning line discipline, channel, and plainness gives that phrase a referent. Help needs no clause of its own because rwlywqrk already renders it under the same conventions. Plainness is a decided constraint: styling escapes would break pipe-into-grep and agent parsers.
